value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. BS totals, income statement through net profit with parent/NCI split and EPS, and cash flow (CFO/CFI/CFF/net change/opening and closing cash) transcribed from rendered pages for FY2025, FY2024, Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1/H1 2026 and, from the special-purpose combined set, H1 2024 and FY2023, FY2022, FY2021 (11 transcript docs from 8 files; the combined set yields three). All identities pass (BS equation, income build and parent plus NCI, CF sum and roll, gross profit, six revenue/gross-profit/net-profit quarter-sum chains including the 2024 comparatives). Only 6 cross-filing differences, all declared with both values: FY2024 CFI -93,108 and CFF 14,776 in the FY2024 audit vs -81,108 and 2,776 in FY2025 comparatives (12,000 of dividends to non-controlling interests moved from investing to financing); FY2023 EPS 0.44 vs 44.7 and H1 2024 EPS 0.76 vs 78.1 (pre-restructuring share basis in the combined set); Q1 2025 opening and closing cash 174,173/196,054 vs 174,172/196,053 in the Q1 2026 comparatives (rounding). Revenue, profit, assets and equity never differ between filings. Seasonality: Q3 2025 is a loss (-18,207) because the summer quarter has little tuition revenue, so Q3 is not a run-rate.
